settings.label: Media Directory
settings.description:
Each sub-folder becomes a channel.
For per-channel numbers and exclusions, create tv_channels.json in the data directory.

settings.label: Tune In
settings.description:
[RANDOM] starts a fresh episode each time you flip to a channel.
[RESUME] picks up where you left that channel.

settings.label: Episode Order
settings.description:
[SEQUENTIAL] airs episodes in order, wrapping at the end.
[RANDOM] shuffles, playing each once before repeating.
Also toggleable from the TV guide.

settings.label: Ads On Picked Episode
settings.description:
Play a commercial break before an episode you chose yourself
from a channel's episode list.
Breaks between episodes are unaffected.

settings.label: Rescan Channels
settings.description: Re-read the media directory and rebuild the channel lineup.
